_doc: Sprites backdrops (owner, 2026-11-01 08:05: 'Implement them all as choices, with adjustable speed settings'). speed is a multiplier of the designed motion: 0 = frozen (delivered as a wallpaper PNG), default = as designed, max = the concept's limit. fps = the live window's fixed frame rate. Design notes and budgets: visualize/docs/MACHINE_BACKGROUNDS.md. Shader: backdrops.sl.

backdrops.name: Abyssal Starfield
backdrops.desc: A deep, still night: sparse colourless stars over navy dust.

backdrops.name: Slow Tide
backdrops.desc: Broad bands of dark indigo and teal that swell and recede over 11 to 23 minutes.

backdrops.name: Threshold Tunnel
backdrops.desc: A very faint spiral tunnel. The rings never move (moving rings look like the needs-you ripple); speed turns only its hue and petals.

backdrops.name: Caustic Floor
backdrops.desc: The faint light-net on a sea floor far below the surface, re-forming slowly.

backdrops.name: Aurora Veil
backdrops.desc: A dim green-teal curtain low across the top, swaying over 9 to 14 minutes. No red.

backdrops.name: Nebula Dust
backdrops.desc: Cold interstellar dust with dark lanes for the sprites to glow in.

backdrops.name: Ink Bloom
backdrops.desc: A plume of indigo ink unfurling in still water over an hour and a half.

backdrops.name: Interference Field
backdrops.desc: Soft fringes of two far-off ripples. Caution: the sweeping fringes resemble the VPN-lost searchlight.

backdrops.name: Marine Snow
backdrops.desc: Faint grey flakes sinking through dark water. Moving points: watch that they never read as sprites.

backdrops.name: Hadal Glow
backdrops.desc: One enormous, barely-there glow from below. The quietest choice.

backdrops.name: Starfield
backdrops.desc: Still stars. Every ten minutes or so a faint comet crosses slowly, far away.

backdrops.name: Starfield, travelling
backdrops.desc: Stars drifting past very slowly, as though you are travelling, with the same distant comets.
